thread.title: What’s coming in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s streaming-TV service?

author: Karen
title: What’s coming in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s streaming-TV service?
text:
October 11, 2018 What’s coming in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s streaming-TV service?
Walter Isaacson wrote that Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) ’s founder Steve Jobs told him seven years ago, that he’d cracked the code on bringing the television into the digital age. But the world is still waiting even after 7 years later, Apple Inc. is not giving up even if it isn’t revolutionizing the media industry.
Apple Inc. (AAPL) is preparing for a “new digital video service” that will unite the original content makers and the subscription services from legacy media companies.
The company will let the users of its devices watch its yet-to-be-launched streaming video service for free, according to a report by CNBC on Wednesday. Users of Apple iPhones, iPads and Apple TV will find the “TV” service pre-installed, CNBC said, citing unnamed sources.
The company plans to unveil the revamped app is start of next year, but when asked from an Apple spokesman, he declined to comment.
The subscription channels will essentially copy the Amazon’s Prime Video Channel subscriptions and the TV app give the online access to customers so there will be no need to download seperately apps from multiple media providers.
Apple devices owners such as the Apple TV, iPad and iPhone will find the still-in-the-works service in the pre-installed “TV” application, said the people, who asked not to be named because the details of the project are private.
The product will include Apple-owned content, which will be free to Apple device owners, and subscription “channels,” which will allow customers to sign up for online-only services, such as those from HBO and Starz. About Karen
